scope: fixed RAM destinations of LZ77-compressed text archives, and the budget each decoded archive must fit
finding: 2026-10-04: the Korean archive 7 (mail bodies) decodes to 17,492 bytes at 0x02028000 while archive 6 (mail header names) is decoded to 0x0202B000 right after, 12,288 bytes on; the mail screen RAM snapshot (analysis/runtime/user_save_mail_snap_01) showed archive 7 running on to 0x0202C454 under archive 6

mail_header_move.evidence: 0x0202C454..0x0202E000 was zero on the mail screen; the next fixed buffer literal in the window is 0x0202DE00 (0x0804A80C/0x0804AC78), so archive 6 must end before it; 0x0202B000 has exactly two literal words per revision, the decompress call and the header reader

budget_basis: archive 7: up to the moved header buffer; archive 6: up to 0x0202DE00; 4/14/61 share 0x02028000 and are held to the original 12,288 bytes before 0x0202B000; BBS bodies 18/20/22/24/26/28 decode to 0x0202A000 (board reader 0x0804946A) and must end before 0x0202DE00; BBS lists 19..29 decode to 0x02026000 and are held before 0x02028000
